scenarios.question: 场景亮度不符合预期，而且方向光没有阴影。应检查哪些光照单位、阴影支持条件和开关？

completion_checks.criterion: Distinguish directional illuminance in Lux from local-light luminousFlux/luminance and nt2lm size conversion; do not use a universal brightness scalar.
Explain HDR/LDR slot, camera exposure and local-light meter-scale differences with the required preconditions.
Ordinary directionals share one effective scene.renderScene.mainLight; inspect its identity, rather than expecting an added ordinary directional to provide fill.
Distinguish main directional/Spot ShadowMap support from Point/Sphere non-support, and Planar from ShadowMap including documented validation limits.
Give all four independent shadow switches: global enabled, ShadowMap type, light shadowEnabled and renderer shadowCastingMode ON; retain world-bounds/culling preconditions.
Treat source/default-bundle lookups and historical candidate/browser evidence as scoped evidence, not a current runtime pass; provide corresponding document references.

read_protocol.operator: Independent cold native assistant reader; inherited same model deployment with no override. The runtime does not expose an exact model build identifier.
read_protocol.reading_method: Manual document reading in a fresh context. First receive the entire frozen host-minimal L0, then the full router exactly once. Independently select the owner and only the necessary references. Return whole UTF-8 file payloads; record every repeated read.
read_protocol.stop_condition: Stop when the unchanged frozen question can be answered completely. Seal the answer before revealing completion checks; do not read more or edit the sealed answer after seeing them.
read_protocol.field_rendering: host-minimal: serialize each of 22 name+description records in lexical name order using air-routing-1, joined by one newline; count exactly once.
read_protocol.tool_text_scope: Count actual document payload Unicode code points, UTF-8 bytes and uniform rough token estimate; exclude fixed tool wrappers, the question and answer. Count repeated actual reads. Never substitute internal file output for a truncated reader-visible response.
read_protocol.receipts: The actual reader attests untruncated L0 and every document payload, with tool call receipts. Set both inner command and outer function output budgets to 30000. A truncated response with unrecoverable exact received text invalidates cost and must be preserved as a failure.
read_protocol.answer_review: After sealing, completion-check evidence must quote exact text in the sealed answer; record failure honestly. No source execution or browsing beyond the frozen snapshot.
